zh: 本页保留 R0.61 到 R0.73U 的全部 137 个节点。R0.61–R0.69W 从约化递推走到严格环带排除；R0.70A–R0.71Z 检查移动尺度、临界账本、内部 entry 与 complete-root 边界；R0.72A–R0.73B 处理 strong coupling、critical log、碰撞几何与完整线性 Fourier--Leray 行；R0.73C–I 依次处理冻结 Rayleigh 不稳定、黏性谱簇持续、固定正半平面传递、移动剖面增益、非线性相对放大、平面固定距离偏离与零窗口作用量边界。R0.73J 认证无黏连续谱支，R0.73K 闭合参数一致的黏性 rank-one 谱支，R0.73L 把冻结谱支升级为真实非自治 selected action；R0.73M 再用完整 action 指定种子，并在固定物理时刻闭合二维非线性固定距离偏离。背景随 \(\Lambda\) 改变，轨道留在精确二维不变子空间；prefactor 极限、两项 WKB、固定背景、横向三维、奇性与 Clay 没有被外推。 R0.73M 证明：当 \(\Lambda\to\infty\) 且背景随之改变时，按完整作用量 缩小的平面扰动可以在固定时刻保持固定阶输出。R0.73N 补上固定成员审计： 任意共存强解满足有限累积应变控制；平面扰动全局满足 \(L^2\) 稳定估计； 足够小的全三维 \(H^3\) 扰动落在正的全局强解稳定管内。因此，R0.73M 中的量词顺序不能交换为一个固定背景上的任意小输入、固定距离逃逸。 R0.73O 关闭了已知全局无强迫背景上的 \(H^3\)-小扰动不稳定路线：每条轨道最终衰减，累积 \(H^4\) 作用量有限，并有一个对所有起始时刻有效的正稳定半径。强迫对照保留无限累积应变，并由平面方向给出全局光滑、初始 \(H^3\) 趋零而输出固定 \(L^2\) 逃逸的见证。 R0.73P 关闭了固定全局强轨道周围的临界稳定与带限输入接口：临界管对所有起始时刻有效，\(N^{-1/2}\) 指数对范数转移精确，并允许 \(L^2\) 趋零而 \(H^3\) 发散的光滑扰动。能量球内所有弱分支在共同延迟后正则并相对参考轨道同步；不能跨越的部分是此前的早期弱区间。 这一节用周期 Stokes--HLS 双线性估计和有限 Volterra 递推，构造了一个全起点统一的临界热流稳定管。精确 Fourier 族证明它加入了旧 \(H^{1/2}\) 管之外的光滑安全数据；裸 Kato 上确界则被一个时间端点反例阻断。whole-space Besov 开放性属于已知文献，Clay 结论仍开放。 我把 R0.73R 的当前价值评为“可靠的桥接引理与反例工具”，而不是高水平正则性主定理。可保留之处是：分层拆开能量、加法几何与高阶相位；给出有限 Fourier 数据可复算的严格证书；用同谱确定性族证明二次能谱不足。 本节真正完成的是三件较窄但可用的工作。 限定式碰撞检索没有发现与“标量能量密度自相关 \(A Q\) + 两个精确非自治见证”完全相同的打包，但有限检索不是新颖性或优先权证明。本站只把它称为可审计的本地综合。 我对 R0.73U 的价值判断是：它没有解决全局正则性，但把 R0.73T 的两个信息缺口分开了。
en: This page retains all 137 nodes from R0.61 through R0.73U. R0.61–R0.69W progresses from reduced recurrences to rigorous annular exclusion; R0.70A–R0.71Z examines moving scales, critical ledgers, internal entry, and the complete-root boundary; R0.72A–R0.73B treats strong coupling, the critical log, collision geometry, and the complete linear Fourier--Leray row; R0.73C–I then treats frozen Rayleigh instability, persistence of viscous spectral clusters, transfer in a fixed positive half-plane, moving-profile gain, nonlinear relative amplification, planar fixed-distance deviation, and the zero-window action boundary. R0.73J certifies an inviscid continuous spectral branch, R0.73K closes a parameter-consistent viscous rank-one spectral branch, and R0.73L upgrades the frozen spectral branch to a genuinely nonautonomous selected action; R0.73M then uses the full action to specify the seed and closes two-dimensional nonlinear fixed-distance deviation at a fixed physical time. The background varies with \(\Lambda\), while the orbit remains in an exact two-dimensional invariant subspace; no extrapolation is made to the prefactor limit, two-term WKB, a fixed background, transverse three-dimensional dynamics, singularity, or Clay. R0.73M proves that when \(\Lambda\to\infty\) and the background varies with it, planar perturbations reduced according to the full action can retain order-one output at a fixed time. R0.73N adds the fixed-member audit: every coexisting strong solution has finite accumulated-strain control; planar perturbations obey a global \(L^2\) stability estimate; sufficiently small fully three-dimensional \(H^3\) perturbations lie inside a positive global strong-solution stability tube. Thus the quantifier order in R0.73M cannot be exchanged for arbitrarily small input and fixed-distance escape on one fixed background. R0.73O closes the small-\(H^3\)-perturbation instability route around known global unforced backgrounds: every orbit eventually decays, the accumulated \(H^4\) action is finite, and a positive stability radius works for every starting time. The forced comparison retains infinite accumulated strain and provides, in the planar direction, a globally smooth witness with initial \(H^3\) tending to zero and fixed \(L^2\) output escape. R0.73P closes the critical-stability and band-limited-input interface around a fixed global strong orbit: the critical tube works for every starting time, the \(N^{-1/2}\) exponent is exact for norm transfer, and smooth perturbations may have \(L^2\) tending to zero while \(H^3\) diverges. Every weak branch in the energy ball becomes regular after a common delay and synchronizes with the reference orbit; the earlier weak interval remains inaccessible. That section uses a periodic Stokes--HLS bilinear estimate and a finite Volterra recurrence to construct a critical heat-flow stability tube uniform over all starting times. An exact Fourier family proves that it includes smooth safe data outside the earlier \(H^{1/2}\) tube, while a time-endpoint counterexample blocks the bare Kato supremum. Whole-space Besov openness is known in the literature, and the Clay conclusion remains open. I assess the current value of R0.73R as a reliable bridging lemma and counterexample tool, not as a major regularity theorem. Its reusable parts are the separation of energy, additive geometry, and higher-order phase; rigorous certificates recomputable from finite Fourier data; and a deterministic isospectral family showing that quadratic energy spectra are insufficient. This section completes three narrower but usable tasks. A restricted collision search found no package identical to scalar energy-density autocorrelation \(A Q\) plus two exact non-autonomy witnesses, but a finite search is not proof of novelty or priority. This site calls it only an auditable local synthesis. My assessment of R0.73U is that it does not solve global regularity, but it separates the two information gaps left by R0.73T.
